description:
Located at 1644 Fulton Street #2, this spacious second-floor flat blends classic San Francisco charm with modern updates. Renovated in late 2024, it features a contemporary kitchen with custom cabinetry and full-size appliances, and an open living room with hardwood floors, a bay window, and a decorative fireplace. It includes three bright bedrooms, with the primary having an en-suite bathroom, alongside two updated full bathrooms. Additional amenities include shared laundry, secure off-street garage parking, and a prime NOPA location near the Divisadero Corridor and Alamo Square Park, providing easy access to dining, shops, and public transportation.

Hello! I’m currently seeking a new roommate to share my Bed-Stuy apartment with. There will only be 2 of us.
The Apartment: Besides your room, the apartment is fully furnished (couch, dining table, pots/pans/vitamix/microwave), so it is probably best that you don’t have too many belongings. "Laundry on site" refers to the portable washing machine I run from the kitchen sink, perfectly suits mine and my current roommates needs. After living in NYC for 13 years, this is the ONLY apartment where I have never seen a pest. 4 blocks away from HVK, equidistant from the Bedford-Nostrand G stop and the Nostrand A/C.
It is a 2.5 bedroom and 2 bathroom in an open layout with ceiling fans. Common area is quite spacious. The half bedroom is currently used for storage and I keep a desk in there that I work or study from occasionally. There is room for your items in the existing storage furniture, including half of the drawers in a dresser, half of the closet, and a coat/shoe rack. You could probably fit a dresser or small/medium desk in there as well. Your bathroom would be off the kitchen, and close to your bedroom. We currently have a little sitting area in the front yard where we can grow flowers and herbs in the spring/summer. I have been told by the landlord we will have sunny backyard access within the year along with a real washer and dryer in the basement. The landlord, by the way, has been kind, attentive, and fair. No smoking cigarettes, and no pets of any kind. Shoes off household. No big parties, but small gatherings are welcome.
The photos here are from before we moved in as the apartment is currently filled with boxes from the current roommate’s departure. While her room is pictured with furniture for scale, the room will be empty by the time you move in.
About me: I am a 37 year old working as a medical researcher with a hybrid work schedule. I spend my spare time gardening, hiking, arts and crafts & local politics. I also spend a fair amount of time hanging out with my family in New Jersey, especially in the summer. Come fall of 2027 I will be going back to school and continuing to work full time, so I probably won’t be around too much. After years of craigslist roommates, proud to say almost all of them have worked out positively. I’ve had situations where a craigslist roommate becomes a friend I stay in touch with for years, and perfectly harmonious situations where we live independent lives and say hello in passing.
About you: , does not work exclusively from home, keeps a CLEAN kitchen, fridge, and freezer, and can sign a yearlong lease. The landlord will run a standard background/credit check, first month’s rent ($1650) and security due upfront ($1650). Available on 10/1, but you can move in as early as 9/17 with pro-rated rent.
Please respond with a little information about yourself! Links to social media are a plus.

A rare Bernal Heights rental with space, privacy, views, outdoor living, and parking, all in one home.
This bright ~1,800 sq ft, 3-bedroom home offers the kind of space that's increasingly hard to find in San Francisco: generous living areas, a private full-floor upper bedroom, beautiful natural light, a private deck, in-unit laundry, and carport parking with EV charger.
THE SPACE
The heart of the home is a large, light-filled living room framed by classic bay windows with beautiful views. Hardwood floors and abundant natural light give the space a warm, open feel, with plenty of room for both everyday living and entertaining.
The home's layout separates living and sleeping spaces, making it especially well suited for a couple or family that wants room to spread out—or anyone looking for a true work-from-home setup without sacrificing a bedroom.
Two bedrooms are located on the main bedroom level.
Then there's the top floor.
The entire upper level is dedicated to the third bedroom, creating a private retreat with skylights, abundant natural light, and its own sink and toilet.
Use it as an oversized primary bedroom, private guest space, bedroom + office, or creative studio.
PRIVATE OUTDOOR SPACE
Step outside onto your private deck for morning coffee, outdoor dinners, or a quiet place to unwind.
It's an extension of the living space and one of the home's standout features.

You get the quieter, residential character of Bernal without feeling removed from the city.

Welcome home to this bright and spacious top-floor 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment in one of San Francisco’s most desirable neighborhoods. Filled with natural light and thoughtfully updated throughout, this inviting home offers generous living spaces, an updated kitchen with dishwasher, and the convenience of one-car parking.
The open living and dining area creates an ideal space for both everyday living and entertaining. The updated kitchen features crisp cabinetry, stone countertops, modern appliances, and a dishwasher, with a dedicated dining area just beyond the kitchen.
The spacious primary bedroom is comfortably sized for a king-size bed, nightstands, and additional furnishings, while the two additional bedrooms can easily accommodate queen-size beds and home office or storage furniture. The thoughtful floor plan gives the primary bedroom and one bathroom their own private wing, separated from the additional bedrooms by the central living area.
Both bathrooms retain the building’s charming vintage character while offering practical layouts. One features a walk-in shower, while the other offers a shower/tub combination. Skylights bring an abundance of natural light into both spaces.
Additional features include newer flooring in the living areas, brand-new bedroom carpeting, double-paned windows throughout, and one-car parking.
An Exceptional Richmond District Location!
This home puts the best of San Francisco’s Richmond District, Golden Gate Park, and Pacific Ocean coastline right outside your door. The neighborhood offers an incredible mix of outdoor recreation, local restaurants, coffee shops, markets, and everyday conveniences—all within easy walking distance.
Spend the morning exploring Golden Gate Park, grab coffee and breakfast along Clement Street, or head west for an afternoon at Baker Beach or Lands End. The neighborhood’s proximity to some of San Francisco’s most spectacular parks, trails, beaches, and scenic overlooks makes this an especially appealing location for anyone who enjoys an active, outdoors-oriented lifestyle.
Bright, spacious, updated, and exceptionally well located—355 24th Avenue #302 is a wonderful place to call home.
